transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net broadband cancellations and billing, my name is Ryan. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Ryan, my name is Elena Rostova. I am calling to claim my speed guarantee compensation credit and penalty-free contract exit because my broadband download speed has been twenty-eight megabits for two weeks when my contract guarantees a minimum of forty-five!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good afternoon Elena. I can look into your line speed profile. Before we inspect your broadband circuit telemetry, could you confirm your full postal address and your account security PIN?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it is 51 Victoria Road, Oxford, OX2 7TA, and my security PIN is 8014. My router model is the Hub 4 with serial number SNET-44018.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Elena, that confirms your account details. What speed testing tool have you been running to record twenty-eight megabits?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I used the official S-Net broadband speed checker app on my desktop computer via a direct Ethernet cable, as instructed in your welcome pack because having a reliable home broadband connection is absolutely essential for our daily household work.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And how many speed tests have you registered through the desktop application over those two weeks in accordance with our standard telecommunications network diagnostic procedures.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I ran fourteen separate tests across morning, afternoon, and night, and every single test clocked between twenty-six and twenty-eight megabits per second so I really appreciate you taking the time to look into these technical details with me today.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Bear with me for a couple of minutes while I check the Openreach copper loop length and sync rate telemetry from our exchange test head across all your connected household devices including laptops, mobile phones, and streaming hardware.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for waiting, Elena. The line sync history shows an automated profile cap of thirty megabits applied following multiple line retrains to maintain optimal throughput and low latency across the regional distribution network.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I am an architect working with thirty-gigabyte BIM rendering files! I have missed two major client planning deadlines because file downloads are taking hours! Your contract explicitly promises twenty pounds automatic credit or penalty-free cancellation if speeds stay below forty-five megabits! It is outrageous being misled like this so I really appreciate you taking the time to look into these technical details with me today.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Residential speed guarantee terms require thirty consecutive days of diagnostic observation before contract exit clauses can be considered in accordance with our standard telecommunications network diagnostic procedures.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Your website and welcome leaflet say three consecutive days below minimum guaranteed speed! Don't invent thirty-day rules to avoid paying my credit since we depend heavily on this service for remote working and family communications every day.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Well if you had actually bothered to read section 8 of our terms and conditions, speed guarantees require consecutive engineer visits before credits apply, so don't accuse customer service of misleading you across all your connected household devices including laptops, mobile phones, and streaming hardware.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How dare you speak to me like that! I am quoting the exact wording from your speed guarantee charter because having a reliable home broadband connection is absolutely essential for our daily household work.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If you wish to dispute contractual speed terms, you must submit a written dispute ticket through our online web portal to ensure your S-Net service operates reliably without unexpected dropped packets or connection faults.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I am on the phone with customer services right now! Open a speed dispute ticket and book an engineer to inspect the line so I really appreciate you taking the time to look into these technical details with me today.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Frontline telephony agents do not submit engineer dispatch requests or speed guarantee compensation credits so that your account records and provisioning parameters remain completely up to date.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Then transfer me immediately to a manager who has the authority to book an engineer and credit my account!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Team supervisors do not take speed guarantee dispute calls. You need to log into your online account and fill out the automated speed claim form.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: You refuse to book an engineer, you refuse to issue the contract credit, and you refuse to let me speak to a supervisor! This is appalling service!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am informing you of the mandatory administrative procedure for speed guarantee disputes.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you at least reset the automated profile cap on the exchange port to see if my speed increases back to forty-five megabits right now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Bear with me for two minutes while I send a remote profile reset command to the DSLAM port card.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for waiting, Elena. The DSLAM port has been re-initialized and the speed cap removed.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Let me run another speed test on the desktop app right now... It is syncing at forty-six megabits! Forty-six point two megabits download!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Which model of Hub router is currently plugged into the master socket?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: As I said right at the start of the call, it is the Hub 4 router.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously copper attenuation increases significantly over long line runs from the street cabinet.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Well, the remote line reset has brought the speed above the forty-five megabit threshold for the moment.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now that your download speed has recovered to forty-six megabits, the speed guarantee exit clause is no longer applicable.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will monitor it closely over the weekend. What is the ticket reference for the line reset you performed?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The reference code for the port reset is TKT-77019-S.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: TKT-77019-S, noted down.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have logged the diagnostic results on your customer profile.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: If the speed drops below forty-five megabits again, I will be straight back on the phone demanding an engineer visit.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The line profile is set to dynamic rate adaptation to maintain stability.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Very well, thank you for at least resetting the port.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there any other aspect of your broadband connection I can help you with today, Elena?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Our automated network management systems will monitor your line stability parameters over the next forty-eight hours.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Please make sure those automated monitoring logs are retained on my customer file.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: All telemetry readings are permanently attached to ticket reference TKT-77019-S.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That provides a clear audit trail if speeds degrade again.
